Sandbox_TrueHordes_Enabled_tooltip: Turns the True Hordes simulation on or off for this world.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes extra [TrueHordes] lines to console.txt. Leave off unless testing.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BuildingZombiesSeeded: New games: every building's zombies exist from day one (held by the mod, able to leave buildings), instead of appearing when a room is first seen. Makes mods like Wake Them Up unnecessary.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_EdgeArrivalMonths: Months until newcomers arrive from the map edges
Sandbox_TrueHordes_EdgeArrivalMonths_too: Respawned zombies first appear in long-unseen areas; over this many months a growing share walks in from the map's edges instead. 0 = always from the edges.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StragglerOneIn: Stragglers: 1 in N never join hordes
Sandbox_TrueHordes_StragglerOneIn_toolti: This share of zombies never joins or follows a horde and lingers in or near buildings, so a town is never completely safe. 75 = 1 in 75.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeFormSize: Zombies needed to form a horde
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeFormSize_tooltip: A group moving together becomes a horde at this size. Zombies just standing close together never form one.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_HordeMinSize_tooltip: A horde that shrinks below this size breaks up into single wanderers.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_FollowChance_tooltip: Chance per in-game hour that a wandering zombie that sees another zombie walking falls in behind it. Chains of followers grow into hordes.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_OffRoadChance_tooltip: How often a walking zombie or horde on a road turns off it. Lower keeps more hordes on roads and highways.
Sandbox_TrueHordes_BreakAwayChance_toolt: Chance for each horde member to get left behind when the horde squeezes through an alley or between buildings.
